name: agentuse
stderr:
Usage: agentuse mcp [options] [command]

Manage logins for an agent's MCP servers

Options:
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  login [options] <agent> <server>  Log in to an OAuth MCP server. Every agent
                                    using the same server URL shares the login.
  logout <agent> <server>           Forget the saved login for an OAuth MCP
                                    server
  status <agent>                    Show how each MCP server of an agent signs
                                    in
  help [command]                    display help for command
